question: Why Nations Fail' is co-authored by Daron Acemoglu and _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**James Robinson**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Why Nations Fail** is a widely acclaimed book co-authored by **Daron Acemoglu**, an economist, and **James Robinson**, a political scientist. 
• The book was published in **2012** and explores the fundamental reasons behind the economic success or failure of nations. 
• The central argument revolves around the importance of **inclusive political and economic institutions** in fostering prosperity, while **extractive institutions** lead to stagnation and poverty. 
• **James Robinson**, the co-author, is known for his work on development economics and political theory. He has held prestigious academic positions and collaborated extensively with Acemoglu on various research projects. 
• The book is based on extensive historical examples
